text:
Rita: Heads up — AcmeHealth reported a GDPR/data-residency alert. Their requests for eu-west-1 are being served from us-east-1 and triggering compliance logs + higher latency. Example request id: rq_8f3b2a. Can someone check routing/failover behaviour?

Oncall-SRE: got it. Can you paste the request id + the exact timestamps? Any repro link?

Rita: timestamps: 2024-10-04T14:12:22Z (client), 2024-10-04T14:12:23Z (our ingress). Customer observed ~820ms p95 and a 403-like compliance alert in their dashboard. Here's the audit log snippet we received from their side:

```
{
  "request_id": "rq_8f3b2a",
  "client_region": "eu-west-1",
  "served_region": "us-east-1",
  "fallback_reason": "capacity_unavailable",
  "policy_violation": "data_residency",
  "timestamp": "2024-10-04T14:12:23Z"
}
```

DeployBot: automated alert: autoscaler triggered fallback-policy at 2024-10-04T14:11:58Z; eu-west pool at 98% util.

Mateo: digging into infra metrics now — eu-west GPU pool spiked and hit max for last 9m. There were 3 large long-sequence jobs that ate capacity. Confirming if fallback was allowed for this tenant.

Anna: we didn't change routing policy recently. But the runtime will fallback to any compatible region if local capacity is exhausted unless tenant has residency flag. Looks like AcmeHealth was not flagged as residency-restricted in the routing DB (maybe onboarding metadata mismatch).

Kate: GDPR alert fired because served_region != client_region. We need list of all affected request_ids for legal. Please collect and escalate to compliance.

Rita: customer also reported a billing anomaly — tokens counted in us-east pricing tier. They pasted invoice fragment. I'll open a billing ticket.

BillingBot: auto-ticket created: B-12378 for acct AcmeHealth — investigating cross-region charge mapping.

Ryan: proposal: add a tenant-level opt-out for cross-region fallback (flagged by org metadata) and, short-term, enforce residency exceptions that return 509/region-unavailable instead of auto-fallback. Will require support + product OK. Thoughts?

Oncall-SRE: short-term we can flip a feature-flag to block cross-region fallback globally or per-tenant. That will cause immediate errors for affected requests until capacity recovers. Need comms to affected customers first.

Anna: long-term fix: keep the current fallback but improve routing DB consistency and add explicit audit_reason codes (e.g., "fallback_capacity", "routing_policy_mismatch") so support and security can reconcile quickly. I'll open a PR to add richer audit fields.

Mateo: repro steps for infra team to simulate:
1) Send 1000 parallel requests pinned to eu-west-1 for model-xx-large with seq_length=4096
2) Watch eu-west pool utilization and autoscaler events
3) Observe fallback decisions in router logs (`router.log`)

Rita: for support -> customer repro steps (small, safe):
```bash
# run from EU region to replicate routing preference
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \n  -H "X-Account: acmehealth" \n  -H "X-Client-Region: eu-west-1" \n  -d '{"model":"model-xx-large","input":"test","max_tokens":50}' \n  -D - | sed -n '1,120p'
```
Include header `X-Request-Id: rq_<id>` to correlate.

Kate: collect full list of request ids and timestamps; security will draft notification template. If many requests, legal may prefer anonymized summary instead of per-request disclosure.

Rita: I've pulled 12 request ids so far -> sending to security via secure channel. Also letting AcmeHealth know we're investigating and may temporarily disable cross-region fallback for their org.

Anna: I'll add router log excerpt instrumentation to include `audit_reason` and `tenant_residency_flag` in the next patch. ETA: PR today, rollout to staging tomorrow.

Ryan: cc @product — we should discuss tenant residency flags during next planning. Also need docs update for support-runbooks.

Oncall-SRE: follow-ups: (1) Mateo to throttle long-running jobs in eu-west to free capacity; (2) Support to notify customer and offer emergency dedicated capacity if needed; (3) Billing to reconcile cross-region charges.

Rita: thanks all — I'll keep this thread updated with customer comms. Leaving note for account team. :white_check_mark:
